title: A strict Roos model of the finite dualizing tower
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D$ with algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $R$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Set $A_n=R/\varpi^{n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, and let $\omega_n=Ra_n^!(A_n)_s$ be the prescribed finite dualizing term [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]. There exist a normalized DVR tower $T$ [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower] and isomorphisms $e_n:T.M_n\cong\omega_n$ that identify every transition with the scalar adjunct of the counit-defined finite coefficient comparison. Write $L$ for the value of the published total right derived inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] on $T$. There exist maps $p:L\to\prod_n \operatorname{ev}_nT$ and $\delta:\prod_n\operatorname{ev}_nT\to L[1]$ making the Roos triangle of the actual derived evaluation transitions distinguished. The countable-product witness is the published integralOperationsDerivedCountableProducts.

proof.text: Take the scalar adjuncts of the counit-defined finite comparisons. Their invertibility and unit/cocycle identities give normalization and the finite transition identities.

Use normalizedDVR_strict_realization on the actual finite exceptional transitions, with their unit and cocycle equations, to obtain the strict completed-coefficient tower and all evaluation isomorphisms. Define the normalized DVR datum with the finite dualizing terms themselves and identity e_n. Invertibility of each scalar comparison makes precomposition a Hom bijection; compose with the scalar adjunction homEquiv to prove normalization. The finite comparison is defined as the inverse homEquiv of the transition, so the displayed identification follows by Equiv.apply_symm_apply.

Apply the published total derived inverse limit specification to a complex representing the strict tower. Compare its auxiliary derived evaluation with canonical evaluation using the two factorization isomorphisms through cochain localization. The localization formula for evaluation transitions and naturality identify all transition arrows. Construct the product isomorphism from its component maps and inverses; transport the distinguished Roos triangle and the limit object along these isomorphisms. This works for the published product witness without identifying it with the auxiliary witness.

theorem integralDualizing_roos_model (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] :
    ∃ (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ, T.M n ≅ integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n),
      (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        T.tau h ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).map (e n).hom =
          (e m).hom ≫
            (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (normalizedDVRRes l E X h)).homEquiv _ _
              (integralDualizingFiniteComparison l E D X hl h)) ∧
      (letI : HasCountableProducts (completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl) :=
        integralOperationsDerivedCountableProducts l E X
       ∃ (p : (integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower ⟶
          ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower)
         (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦
          (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower) ⟶
          ((integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
         IsDerivedLimitTriangle
           (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E X D hl n.le_succ).app T.tower)
           ((integralDualizingLimit l E X).obj T.tower) p δ)
